description: Real-world landfill waste images collected at the Whyte's Gully landfill, Wollongong, Australia.
citation: Single, S., Iranmanesh, S., & Raad, R. (2023). RealWaste: A Novel Real-Life Data Set for Landfill Waste Classification Using Deep Learning. Information, 14(12), 633.

mapping_notes.Organic: Food organics and vegetation are combined into a single compostable/organic category.
mapping_notes.General: Miscellaneous trash and textile trash are combined into a general-waste category. Textiles are excluded because they are rarely accepted in curbside recycling.
